announcements.title: Officer applications close June 30
announcements.body: Interested in a leadership role for 2026–27? Applications for Vice President, Treasurer, and Outreach Chair are open through June 30. See the Officers page for details.

announcements.title: Summer plant tour interest form is live
announcements.body: We're coordinating a fall site visit to a Florida nuclear plant. Fill out the interest form linked on the Home page — spots are limited and priority goes to members in good standing.

announcements.title: Thank you to our graduating seniors
announcements.body: Congratulations to the four NAYGN members graduating this spring! Read their reflections and where they're headed in the latest chapter newsletter, coming soon.
